Hello,

Welcome to Animal Shelter channel. 

We are an amateur volunteer team with each individual who rescues animals but does not specialize in uploading videos into YouTube. Then we unite together, share our videos here in order to help rescued videos get discovered and go viral.

Contact us here: info.taiwananimalshelter@gmail.com

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
►Subscribe Now! Click Here: https://goo.gl/oqwXTi
►Thanks For Watching! Like, Share & Comment
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
